text:
Maya: FYI — p95 still OK but p99 in eu-west spiked to ~1.2s during the 3h window last night. I traced a bunch of those to a small cluster of hosts with IO jitter and longer cold-starts.
Ben: can you share the aggregated numbers? how many requests fell into that tail vs overall?
Maya: ~0.5% of requests were >1s, but they were concentrated in 3 pods. GPU utilization was steady ~70% so it's not pure capacity. suspect networking + cold kv-cache misses.
Sanjay: ran an admission-control sim this morning with the new admit curve and a prewarm budget. results: p99 drops from 1.2s -> 0.85s but sustained throughput drops ~6%. GPU hours up ~3%.
Leo: can you paste the sim parameters? curious which knobs bought the wins.
Sanjay: here are the key pieces. admit curve paramization we tested:
```
admit_threshold(q) = base - alpha * log(1 + q)
base=0.98 (success prob), alpha=0.14
prewarm_pool=6 gpus (eu-west), prewarm_ttl=90s
batch_target_ms=25
```
Maya: main tradeoff is the prewarm pool cost vs p99 SLO. With our EU pricing, +3% GPU hours ~ $2.3k/month at current commit.
Ben: can we do a hybrid: smaller prewarm + opportunistic warm-on-demand where we keep KV cache sticky to sessions from big customers?
Maya: that's what I proposed earlier — keep sticky vector cache for top 10% traffic, those get instant warm path. rest hit admit curve.
Sanjay: simulated that too — sticky cache reduced p99 to 0.78s and GPU hours only +1.2%. almost all the remaining tail were network-related hosts though.
Leo: for the network jitter hosts, ops-bot shows a NIC firmware bump last week. ops-bot, any events?
ops-bot: recent event: 2051230000 - eu-west-2 NIC firmware rolling update. 4 hosts failed transiently, kernel retransmit spike observed.
Maya: ok. plan: 1) reduce prewarm_pool to 4 gpus, enable sticky-kv for top-ten tenants, 2) tighten admit curve alpha -> 0.12 during peak, 3) mark the 4 nodes as draining and schedule NIC remediation.
Ben: +1. also add a short-term routing fallback: if p99 > 900ms for >2 consecutive 5m windows route new requests to eu-central warm pool (cost tradeoff)
Sanjay: I'll run updated sim with those params and include expected delta in GPU-hours and p99. ETA 2 hours.
Maya: thanks — post results here and I'll run a quick cost check with finance. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
